This RMarkdown reports the data preparation and analysis. 

## Data Preparations

The data preparation included cleaning the fractures and cohort.The conditions below were met:

1. Had their 1st fx >= 01/04/2012 and <= 31/03/2018 when they were > 50 years old
2. Excluding fracture happening before the birth year.
3. Excluding records that happen outside of study period.
4. Excluding records that happen outside of observation period.
5. Excluding trauma fractures (same day as trauma codes or 3 distinct fracture sites on the same date.
6. Excluding fractures on the same day as death or after death.
7. Clean out using washout period
8. Excluding records on the same day for the same person according to hierarchy (Hip, Spine, NHNS)
9. Excluding not female individuals
10. Excluding individuals without fracture records
11. Excluding index fractures that happen on the last day of observation period
12. Excluding records with insufficient prior observation and/or outside of observation period
13. Excluding records of index fractures where the subject has not turned 50
14. Excluding records happened after cancer
15. Excluding records happened after metabolic bone diseases

```{r echo=FALSE}
library(here)
library(rio)
library(tidyverse)
library(gtsummary)
library(gt)
library(rvest)
library(DT)
```


```{r}
attrition_report <- import(here("CPRD Raw Analysis", "Results", "AttritionReportCoh_Raw.xlsx"))


attrition_report %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Attrition Report for Cleaning Fractures and Cohort**")
  ) %>%
  opt_all_caps() %>% 
    tab_options(
      # table.width = px(600),
      heading.title.font.weight = "bold",
      heading.align = "left"
    ) |> 
  opt_stylize(style = 2) 
```

# Results

## Primary Care

Cohort summary

```{r}
cohort_summary_raw_rp <- import(here("CPRD Raw Analysis", "Results", "cohort_summary_raw.xlsx"))

cohort_summary_raw_rp %>% 
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Cohort Summary Statistics**")
    # subtitle = md("*Subjects Who Visited a Clinically Relevant Consultant*")
  ) %>%
  opt_all_caps() %>% 
    tab_options(
      # table.width = px(600),
      heading.title.font.weight = "bold",
      heading.align = "left"
    ) |> 
  opt_stylize(style = 2) %>% 
  cols_label(
    num_distinct_women = "Number of Subjects",
    num_non_service_users = "Number of Non-services Users",
    perc_non_service_users = "Propotion of Non-services Users",
    num_service_users = "Number of Services Users",
    perc_service_users = "Propotion of Non-services Users"
  )
```


### Visits

User only summary statistics

```{r}
user_only_summary_statistics_rp <- import(here("CPRD Raw Analysis", "Results", "Output_visits_Raw.xlsx"), sheet = "user_only_summary_statistics")

user_only_summary_statistics_rp %>% 
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**User Only Summary Statistics**"),
    subtitle = md("*Subjects Who Visited a Clinically Relevant Consultant*")
  ) %>%
  opt_all_caps() %>% 
    tab_options(
      # table.width = px(600),
      heading.title.font.weight = "bold",
      heading.align = "left"
    ) |> 
  opt_stylize(style = 2) %>% 
  cols_label(
    mean_visit_per_year = "Mean Visits Per Year",
    min_visit_per_year = "Minimum Visits Per Year",
    max_visit_per_year = "Maximum Visits Per Year",
    sd_visit_per_year = "SD Visits Per Year",
    median_visit_per_year = "Median Visits Per Year",
    lower_q_visits_per_year = "Lower Quartile Visits Per Year",
    upper_q_visits_per_year = "Upper Quartile Visits Per Year"
  )
```

Summary statistics of visits by specialty

```{r}
user_only_summary_rp <- import(here("CPRD Raw Analysis", "Results", "Output_visits_Raw.xlsx"), sheet = "user_only_summary")
```


```{r}
colnames(user_only_summary_rp) <- c("Specialty", "Total visits", "Mean visits per year", "SD visits per year", "Minimum visits per year", "Maximum visits per year", "Number of subjects")

datatable(user_only_summary_rp,
    rownames = FALSE, 
    filter = 'top', 
    options = list(
        scrollX = TRUE,  # Allow user to scroll wide tables horizontally
        search = list(regex = FALSE, caseInsensitive = TRUE),
        autoWidth = TRUE,  # Automatically adjust column widths
        columnDefs = list(
          list(targets = c(0, 1, 2), width = "120px"),  # Narrow columns
            list(targets = c(3, 4), width = "300px", className = "text-wrap"), # Wider columns
            list(
                targets = "_all",  # Apply to all columns
                className = "dt-center"  # Center align all columns
            )
        )
    )
)
```
